card.name: Linking words before blood-count terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words or commas (for, including, and, after, following) right before a blood or marrow term such as reticulocyte count, RBC, or neutrophil count. It appears in hematology monitoring and cancer-treatment text.

modes.label: Lists of blood tests
modes.description: A comma or 'including' just before the next blood test in a monitoring list.
modes.example: A complete blood count,<< including>> a reticulocyte count, is

modes.label: Linking word in treatment or response steps
modes.description: A word like for, after, following or and that links a treatment, timing or response criterion to a blood or marrow measure.
modes.example: continue for 7 days<< after>> the neutrophil count rises above

card.writes: It seems to prepare the model to continue with blood-cell or marrow terms, though the promoted tokens are mostly noisy.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words that come just before a blood count or marrow term.
